protocol_versions_published_check.name: protocol_versions_published_check
protocol_versions_published_check.value: "protocol_versions"."status" = 'draft' or ("protocol_versions"."published_at" is not null and "protocol_versions"."definition_sha256" is not null)

participants_enrollment_code_used_check.name: participants_enrollment_code_used_check
participants_enrollment_code_used_check.value: "participants"."enrollment_code_used_at" is null or "participants"."enrollment_code" is not null

sync_batch_files_kind_content_type_check.name: sync_batch_files_kind_content_type_check
sync_batch_files_kind_content_type_check.value: "sync_batch_files"."content_type" = case "sync_batch_files"."kind" when 'video' then 'video/mp4' when 'manifest' then 'application/json' else 'text/csv' end

media_assets_tombstone_check.name: media_assets_tombstone_check
media_assets_tombstone_check.value: ("media_assets"."status" = 'deleted') = ("media_assets"."storage_key" is null) and ("media_assets"."status" = 'deleted') = ("media_assets"."deleted_at" is not null)

discrepancies_side_check.name: discrepancies_side_check
discrepancies_side_check.value: "discrepancies"."activity_report_id" is not null or "discrepancies"."observation_id" is not null

ema_responses_value_check.name: ema_responses_value_check
ema_responses_value_check.value: "ema_responses"."value_numeric" is not null or "ema_responses"."value_choice" is not null
